verses.1: And these are the words of the prophet Jeremiah, who was sent from Jerusalem to the elders of the people, to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people. These words were delivered by Nebuzaradan, the commander of the army in Jerusalem at that time.
verses.2: After the king, the rulers, and the scribes of Judah and Jerusalem left, along with the captives and those who were imprisoned in Jerusalem.
verses.3: In the hands of Elashai son of Shaphan and Gamariah son of Hilkia, who were sent by Zadkiah, king of Judah, to Nebukadnezar, king of Babylon.
verses.4: Thus said Jehovah, the God of Israel, to all the nations who have been scattered from Jerusalem in Babylon.
verses.5: Build houses and sit in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruits.
verses.6: Take women and have children, sons and daughters. Take women for yourselves, and give your children to men. They will then have children and daughters. Increase there, and do not multiply.
verses.7: And they prayed for the peace of the city that I had brought back to you. Pray for it before Jehovah, for in its peace, you will find peace as well.
verses.8: For as Jehovah, the army of Israel’s God, has said: “Do not send out your prophets, who are among you. Do not listen to their dreams, which they themselves dream.”
verses.9: For in falsehood they are brought to you in my name. They are not indeed sent by Jehovah.
verses.10: For as Jehovah said, “Because Babylon has fulfilled seventy years, I will bring about your restoration to their place.”
verses.11: For I know the thoughts that I have in my heart concerning you, oh Jehovah. These are good thoughts, not evil ones. I want to give you these as a gift.
verses.12: And when you called me, you went to me and prayed to me. And I heard your prayers.
verses.13: And if you ask me, I find that you truly desire to hear from me with all your hearts.
verses.14: And I have found you again, O people of Jehovah. I have brought you back to your homeland. I have gathered you together from all the nations and from all the places where I had banished you. Now, O people of Jehovah, I have brought you back to the place where I had sent you away.
verses.15: For you said that Jehovah would create for us angels in heaven.
verses.16: For thus said Jehovah to the king who sits on David’s throne, and to all the people who live in this city: “You are my brothers, for you have not gone out into the battle with them.”
verses.17: So said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “I will send upon them famine, starvation, and destruction. I will make them like birds that cannot be eaten.”
verses.18: And I pursued them in the famine and during times of starvation. I brought suffering upon all the kings of the earth, including those of Shem and Shinar. I brought ruin and destruction to all the nations where they were banished.
verses.19: Under those who did not listen to my words, Jehovah said, “I sent my servants to them, but they did not listen.”
verses.20: And you have heard the words of Jehovah from all over the land, from those I sent out from Jerusalem to Babylon.
verses.21: As Jehovah, the army of Israel’s God, says: “To Ahahaz, son of Colhaias, and to Zadkiya, son of Maaseiah. These are those whom I have sent to you in my name. They are false witnesses. I have given them into the hands of Nabucadrezzar, king of Babylon. Now they will be a spectacle before your eyes.”
verses.22: And from them was taken a curse for all of Judah, who lived in Babylon. It was said that Jehovah would make them just like His own people, and as evil as those who ruled over Babylon were in the fire.
verses.23: Because they committed sorcery in Israel, and they deceived their wives. They spoke lies about me, even though they were not commanded to do so. But I know all this, and the LORD will avenge me.
verses.24: And to Shemaiah the prophet, he shall say:
verses.25: As Jehovah, the army of heaven, said: “Because you sent out messages to all the people in Jerusalem, and also to Saphaniah son of Maasya, the priest, and to all the priests.”
verses.26: Yahweh has appointed you as a priest under Yehoyada. The priest must serve in the house of Yahweh for everyone who is sinner and who needs forgiveness. You were given to him, the one who makes things happen, and to the one who judges.
verses.27: And now, why didn’t you get angry with Jeremiah? I’ve given you the answers that were meant for you.
verses.28: For that reason, Babel was sent to us, saying, “She is a daughter who builds houses, plants gardens, and eats their fruits.”
verses.29: And the priest Zaphania called out this scroll to Jeremiah, the prophet.
verses.30: And the words of Jehovah were sent to Jeremiah, saying:
verses.31: Send out throughout all the land, saying, “As Jehovah said to Shemaiah the prophet, ‘Because I came to you with this message, yet I did not send it out. Instead, I will confirm your faith in falsehood.’”
verses.32: Therefore, as the LORD has said, I will deal with Shemaiah the prophet and his descendants. There will be no one among this people who can sit in their place. They will not see the good that I have done for my people. May the LORD say, “It is better to abandon these people.”
